verification.note: Fresh selected primary introduction p. 4 read and visually collated against the Cambridge publisher preview. Printed pagination retained. The preview is a later manifestation of the original 1993 book; no new publication date inferred. Remaining introduction and complete book not claimed read. This witness is the book itself, distinct from the existing Dyck-review DOI source loc_vernon_politics_1993.

loc_lawrence_taylor_1993.note: Addendum 2026-10-25: primary authorial text freshly read through the public transcription at https://www.scribd.com/document/344407332/Lawrence-y-Taylor-The-Poverty-of-Protest-Gareth-Stedman-Jones-and-the-Politics-of-Language-a-Reply. Selected pp. 1–3 and 10–15 checked. Joint authorship retained. The specific critique is on pp. 13–14; Mayfield and Thorne are the main reply target. No facsimile collation or complete-article reading claimed; earlier publisher-access limitation remains a historical record.

loc_joyce_visions_intro_1991.note: Addendum 2026-10-25: fresh primary introduction p. 10 read and visually collated in Cambridge publisher preview https://assets.cambridge.org/97805214/47973/excerpt/9780521447973_excerpt.pdf.
